canonical.name: Independent-tail replacement errors are decreasing, and summability implies m times the replacement error tends to zero
canonical.reason: New complete local proof constructs prefix conditional means from finite-valued approximants, proves the twice-residual identity and monotonicity, then bounds m delta_m by a summable tail. The published replacement definition is a premise; this new implication is not attributed to an externally read proof.
